maria: Heads-up — observed a 3x tail latency spike on shared-gpu pool g12 around 02:15 UTC. Looks correlated with a heatmap hot-spot for tenant:alpha. Posting the short timeline and a couple quick dumps we grabbed.

sachin: Can you paste the heatmap and the kernel-selector log? wondering if this is a kernel flip issue or batching hysteresis.

maria: quick logs below (trimmed). kernel_selector switching repeatedly, batch_size avg jumps, KV cache hit-rate drops then eviction waves.

maria: ```
[02:14:55] tenant=alpha batch_size=1->16 avg=9 kernel=fp16_fused->int8_vec switch_count=7
[02:15:03] kv_cache: hits=0.72 misses=0.28 evictions=42
[02:15:10] qlen(shared-gpu-g12)=54, in_flight=18, avg_lat=320ms
[02:15:20] ops: soft_lease_release tenant=beta -> reclaim hotset, tenant=alpha eviction_wave=1
```

lee: opsbot shows an auto-throttle event for alpha at 02:16 as well? think the autoscaler bounced a few agents.

opsbot: Auto-throttle triggered: tenant=alpha pool=shared-gpu-g12 reason=kv-eviction-storm throttle=soft-repeat duration=30s @02:16:01 UTC

maria: yep that matches. Heatmap snapshot: https://internal/heatmaps/3332109876 (private). The pattern looks like a single tenant generating many small requests that occasionally coalesce into mid-sized batches which confuse batching heuristic -> kernel selector flips to int8_vec, which increases memory pressure and causes KV evictions.

sachin: Interesting. So culprit flow = high qps of short sequences causing variable batch sizing. That will oscillate batcher thresholds. Could be our batching hysteresis is too short.

lee: Proposed quick mitigation: 1) enforce per-tenant soft max_batch=8 for shared pools, 2) extend batching hysteresis window from 50ms -> 120ms for pools with high churn, 3) temporarily raise KV cache eviction threshold for affected nodes.

maria: I'd add a short-term deploy: soft max_batch per-tenant + metric flag to force kernel choice for a tenant to fp16_fused when sequence length < 512. Low risk and reversible.

infra-bot: Deploy candidate built: rfe/tenant-batch-cap #[PR-4823] -> staging. Includes runtime flag: tenant.batch_soft_cap and kernel_override.

sachin: Can you run a controlled replay with tenant:alpha workload on a staging slice with the new flags? want to see tail latency and eviction curves.

maria: kicked off a 60s replay on staging slice. Command:```./perf_snapshot.sh --pool shared-gpu-g12-staging --tenant alpha --duration 60 --trace kernel-selector,kv````

maria: early result: tail latency drops ~45%, eviction rate down 70%, kernel flips eliminated. Patch seems promising.

lee: Nice. If staging looks good for a couple hours, we can roll to a canary subset of prod nodes and keep autoscaler in monitor-only mode.

sachin: Also add a long-term item: we should add a tenant-level continuous sampler that tracks batch-size variance and picks adaptive hysteresis per pool-tenant pair. Filed as TODO-rls: perf-1347.

maria: filed and linked in the PR description. For now I'll coordinate canary rollout tomorrow 03:00 UTC and monitor KV eviction and kernel_switch_count. :thumbsup:

lee: Thanks — ping me for post-canary review. :eyes:

maria: Thanks all. I'll post a short postmortem if canary confirms.
